text:
Maya: FYI — LuminaHealth flagged a multi-team rollout next quarter, looks like org-level adoption. They want us in the governance call and a capacity plan.
Ben: Awesome, any estimate on teams / traffic?
Maya: They said 3 product squads immediately, plus a data-science team for embeddings. Rough ask: support 4x current qps and embeddings-heavy batch jobs.
LuminaOps: Confirming — our Spike project moves to prod April 15. Expected steady-state: ~1.8M tokens/day (peak 220 rps), embeddings batch overnight (~50k vectors). We need retention and auditing for PII.
Iris: Sounds like Dedicated or Reserved config. Quick calc: peak 220 rps -> recommend 2 reserved pods with autoscale + burst. For embeddings batch we should provision a separate GPU pool or schedule during off-peak.
Jun: Timeline check — can we agree on onboarding windows? We need two enablement sessions (dev + infra) and access to audit logs. Prefer week of Apr 6 for training.
Maya: @Ben — this is looking like an expansion/opportunity for renewal add-on. They mentioned security controls and SLA as buying criteria. Can you join next Tuesday's exec sync?
Ben: On it. I'll prep a renewal addendum + pricing for Reserved capacity. Also want to lock a PO cadence to avoid late renewal risk.
Maya: Action items: 1) Iris to propose capacity config + cost delta by EOD tomorrow. 2) Jun to schedule onboarding sessions w/ LuminaOps. 3) Ben to surface renewal/commit options in sync.
Iris: Draft config snippet I sent to the customer (short):
```
model: redwood-7b
reserved_pods: 2
burst_capacity: 1
embeddings_pool: scheduled_nightly
quota_policy: customer-committed
```
Iris: For auditing they need KMS + access logs; confirm if Private deployment required or managed KMS will suffice.
LuminaOps: Managed KMS and org-level audit logs are fine, Private is not necessary for now. Can you also add a retry/fallback plan? We had a downstream concern last month.
Maya: Noted — we'll include rollout fallback to smaller model and cross-region failover.
RedwoodBot: Reminder: create a customer plan card in CS board and tag @Ben, @Jun, @Iris.
Ben: I'll set up the PO + renewal draft after the call. Also capturing customer feedback: they want clearer guidance on embedding batch best practices — Jun, can you add an enablement doc to the invite?
Jun: Will do. I'll attach the embeddings playbook and a short checklist. Playbook link: https://redwood.dev/playbooks/embeddings-onboarding
Maya: Great. Recording notes here so we don't lose thread. Low immediate renewal risk but big expansion signal — treating as priority. :rocket:
LuminaOps: Thanks everyone — appreciate the quick turnaround. We'll confirm exact numbers tomorrow.
